basic_details.job_title: IIT Jodhpur Senior Project Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur (IIT Jodhpur) has announced 1 vacancy for the Senior Project Manager post on a project-based tenure of 12 Months, with further extension on a year-to-year basis subject to satisfactory performance as per the institute norms. Applicants must possess a Post Graduate Degree with 55% marks or equivalent and 8 years relevant experience, or CA/ICWA/CS with 5 years of relevant experience. The notified pay is Rs. 56,000-2,800-8400 (Upto). Eligible candidates can apply online through the provided website link before the application deadline of 16 October 2026.

how_to_apply: Visit the official online recruitment portal at the designated link provided by IIT Jodhpur.
Complete the online application form with the required personal, educational, and professional details before the deadline of 16-10-2026 at 11:55 PM.

content_sections.heading: IIT Jodhpur Senior Project Manager at a Glance

rows.details: 12 Months (with further extension on a year-to-year basis)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Senior Project Manager position must meet the essential educational and experience requirements specified below: Essential Qualifications: Post Graduate Degree with 55% marks or equivalent and 8 years relevant experience, OR CA/ICWA/CS + 5 years of relevant experience. Desirable Qualifications: CA with 5 years of experience in accounting, taxation and finance, OR B.Com. and M.Com. with 8 years of experience in accounting, taxation and finance. Experience and Knowledge: Experience in filing, handling matters and compiling on GST, Income Tax, International fund transfers and taxations, returns filing on relevant portals of GST, IT, TDS, 15 CA/CB and GST; Accounting, preparation of all financial reports, annual accounts, utilization certificates of various funded projects, and annual grant exemption applications to Income Tax for TDS exemption certificates. Knowledge of GFR, Receipt and Payment Rules, GoI, PFMS, and audit compliance procedures. Experience in Tally ERP 9 for managing accounting as per Indian Government Accounting Standards (IGASs). Strong analytical, documentation, and reporting skills with proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and excellence in verbal and non-verbal communication for noting, letter drafting, and minutes preparation. Age Limit: Maximum 45 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation for the Senior Project Manager is Rs. 56,000-2,800-8400 (Upto). The initial tenure is 12 months, with further extension on a year-to-year basis subject to satisfactory performance as per institute norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Jodhpur Senior Project Manager
content_sections.text: Visit the official online recruitment portal at the designated link provided by IIT Jodhpur. Complete the online application form with the required personal, educational, and professional details before the deadline of 16-10-2026 at 11:55 PM.
